claims.statement: The exercised installed Windows environment and reviewed generic partitions can resume and complete one bounded campaign, freeze and run traceable P0/P1 remediation waves through the existing mission, preserve P2/P3 and protected controls, and derive a current closure report.

population.partitionRule: Versioned reviewed fixtures partition campaign behavior by definition validity, inventory and discovery completeness, finding disposition, work admission, frozen-wave execution, ownership and effect controls, interruption and host recovery, re-review, report consistency, budget state, and terminal closure.
population.residualSpace: Other models and providers, unreviewed repositories and defect classes, long-duration behavior beyond bounded proof, locked interactive credentials after reboot, Linux or macOS host integration, multi-repository campaigns, additional playbooks, and protected product or external effects remain outside the claim.

materialExclusions: Universal defect discovery or semantic correctness for every project
Concurrent source writers or concurrent campaigns in one worktree
Remote mutation, deployment, release, credentials, or destructive external effects
Autonomous resolution of protected product, security, privacy, authorization, legal, or policy decisions
unknowns: No provider-free campaign core or reviewed fixture population has been implemented or captured.
No configured semantic campaign or real frozen-wave mission handoff has been observed.
The installed Windows supervisor and restart-reentry boundary has not been exercised.
No declared population member has a terminal observation.
Required critical writer-safety SDET and fresh evidence-sufficiency challenge have not run.
claims.maximumSupportedClaim: Planning artifacts define the intended autonomous campaign workflow and reviewed proof population; no runtime, restart-recovery, cross-project, or remediation-completion behavior claim is currently supported.
